Pedro I was Emperor from 1822-10-12 to 1831-04-07 (Hereditary: acclaimed Emperor on 12 Oct 1822, after proclaiming independence on 7 Sep 1822; no popular vote.).

Provisional Triune Regency (Lima e Silva, Vergueiro, Carneiro de Campos) was Regent from 1831-04-07 to 1831-06-17 (Elected by the senators and deputies present in the capital after Pedro I abdicated.).
Permanent Triune Regency (Costa Carvalho, Bráulio Muniz, Lima e Silva) was Regent from 1831-06-17 to 1835-10-12 (Elected by the General Assembly under art. 123 of the 1824 Constitution.).
Diogo Antônio Feijó was Regent from 1835-10-12 to 1837-09-19 (Elected sole regent in 1835 with about 6,000 votes (source does not say who voted).).

Pedro de Araújo Lima was Regent from 1837-09-19 to 1840-07-23 (Interim regent after Feijó resigned; elected sole regent in April 1838, easily beating Holanda Cavalcanti (source gives no exact start date for the elected term).).
Pedro II was Emperor from 1840-07-23 to 1889-11-15 (Hereditary; declared of age at 14 on 23 Jul 1840 (nominal emperor since 7 Apr 1831).).
Deodoro da Fonseca was President from 1889-11-15 to 1891-11-23 (Military coup of 15 Nov 1889 (head of Provisional Government); elected President by the Constituent Congress in Feb 1891.).
Floriano Peixoto was President from 1891-11-23 to 1894-11-15 (Succeeded as vice president after Deodoro resigned.).

Prudente de Morais was President from 1894-11-15 to 1898-11-15 (Direct election, 1 Mar 1894: 80.15% of votes cast (276,583; Agência Senado cites about 291,000 of 351,000). Electorate about 800,000 (5.6% of the population).).
Campos Sales was President from 1898-11-15 to 1902-11-15 (Direct election 1898: 90.90% of votes.).
Rodrigues Alves was President from 1902-11-15 to 1906-11-15 (Direct election 1902: 91.71% of votes.).
Afonso Pena was President from 1906-11-15 to 1909-06-14 (Direct election 1906: 97.92% of votes.).
Nilo Peçanha was President from 1909-06-14 to 1910-11-15 (Succeeded as vice president when Afonso Pena died.).
Hermes da Fonseca was President from 1910-11-15 to 1914-11-15 (Direct election 1910: 57.07% of votes (Rui Barbosa 31.49%).).
Venceslau Brás was President from 1914-11-15 to 1918-11-15 (Direct election 1914: 91.60% of votes.).

Delfim Moreira was President from 1918-11-15 to 1919-07-28 (Vice president who took over because the elected president Rodrigues Alves (99.06% in 1918) fell ill with Spanish flu before inauguration and died in Jan 1919.).
Epitácio Pessoa was President from 1919-07-28 to 1922-11-15 (Special direct election 1919: 71.00% of votes (Rui Barbosa 28.86%).).
Artur Bernardes was President from 1922-11-15 to 1926-11-15 (Direct election 1922: 56.03% of votes (Nilo Peçanha 38.13%).).
Washington Luís was President from 1926-11-15 to 1930-10-24 (Direct election 1926: 98.00% of votes.).
Military junta of 1930 (Tasso Fragoso, Mena Barreto, Isaías de Noronha) was Military junta from 1930-10-24 to 1930-11-03 (Seized power by military coup, deposing Washington Luís.).
Getúlio Vargas was President from 1930-11-03 to 1934-07-20 (Head of the Provisional Government after the Revolution of 1930 (armed seizure of power; Júlio Prestes won the 1930 vote with 57.68%).).
Getúlio Vargas was President from 1934-07-20 to 1937-11-10 (Indirectly elected by the Constituent Assembly (1934).).
Getúlio Vargas was President from 1937-11-10 to 1945-10-29 (Self-coup of 10 Nov 1937 (Estado Novo); no elections held.).

José Linhares was President from 1945-10-30 to 1946-01-31 (President of the Supreme Court, called by the Armed Forces to take over after Vargas was deposed (pt Wikipedia gives 30 Oct; English list gives 29 Oct).).
Eurico Gaspar Dutra was President from 1946-01-31 to 1951-01-31 (Direct election 1945: 55.39% of votes; electorate 7.46 million registered.).
Getúlio Vargas was President from 1951-01-31 to 1954-08-24 (Direct election 1950: 48.73% of votes (plurality).).
Café Filho was President from 1954-08-24 to 1955-11-08 (Succeeded as vice president after Vargas's death.).
Carlos Luz was President from 1955-11-08 to 1955-11-11 (As president of the Chamber of Deputies, assumed the presidency when Café Filho took leave.).
Nereu Ramos was President from 1955-11-11 to 1956-01-31 (Vice president of the Senate, installed after Congress removed Luz.).
Juscelino Kubitschek was President from 1956-01-31 to 1961-01-31 (Direct election 1955: 35.68% of votes (plurality).).
Jânio Quadros was President from 1961-01-31 to 1961-08-25 (Direct election 1960: 48.26% of votes (plurality).).
Ranieri Mazzilli was President from 1961-08-25 to 1961-09-07 (President of the Chamber of Deputies, interim after Quadros resigned while vice president Goulart was in China.).
João Goulart was President from 1961-09-07 to 1964-04-02 (Succeeded as vice president; accepted a parliamentary system until it was reversed by plebiscite in Jan 1963.).
Ranieri Mazzilli was President from 1964-04-02 to 1964-04-15 (As president of the Chamber, assumed the presidency after Goulart was deposed.).
Humberto de Alencar Castelo Branco was President from 1964-04-15 to 1967-03-15 (Elected by the purged Congress under Institutional Act No. 1 after the coup.).
Artur da Costa e Silva was President from 1967-03-15 to 1969-08-31 (Indirect election by Congress (single candidate).).

Military junta of 1969 (Lira Tavares, Souza Melo, Rademaker) was Military junta from 1969-08-31 to 1969-10-30 (Army, Navy and Air Force ministers took power, blocking vice president Pedro Aleixo's succession.).
Emílio Garrastazu Médici was President from 1969-10-30 to 1974-03-15 (Chosen by the military command and ratified by Congress.).
Ernesto Geisel was President from 1974-03-15 to 1979-03-15 (Indirect election by an electoral college.).
João Figueiredo was President from 1979-03-15 to 1985-03-15 (Indirect election by an electoral college.).

José Sarney was President from 1985-03-15 to 1990-03-15 (Vice president on the Tancredo Neves ticket (elected by the electoral college in Jan 1985); acting from 15 Mar 1985 and president after Neves died 21 Apr 1985.).
Fernando Collor was President from 1990-03-15 to 1992-12-29 (Direct election 1989: 53.03% of votes in the 2nd round (electorate 82.07 million).).
Itamar Franco was President from 1992-12-29 to 1995-01-01 (Vice president; acting from 29 Sep 1992 and president after Collor resigned.).
Fernando Henrique Cardoso was President from 1995-01-01 to 1999-01-01 (Direct election 1994: 54.28% in the 1st round.).
Fernando Henrique Cardoso was President from 1999-01-01 to 2003-01-01 (Direct election 1998: 53.06% in the 1st round (after the 1997 constitutional amendment allowing re-election).).
Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was President from 2003-01-01 to 2007-01-01 (Direct election 2002: 61.27% in the 2nd round.).
Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was President from 2007-01-01 to 2011-01-01 (Direct election 2006: 60.83% in the 2nd round.).
Dilma Rousseff was President from 2011-01-01 to 2015-01-01 (Direct election 2010: 56.05% in the 2nd round.).
Dilma Rousseff was President from 2015-01-01 to 2016-08-31 (Direct election 2014: 51.64% in the 2nd round.).
Michel Temer was President from 2016-08-31 to 2019-01-01 (Vice president; acting president from 12 May 2016 and president after Dilma's removal.).
Jair Bolsonaro was President from 2019-01-01 to 2023-01-01 (Direct election 2018: 55.13% in the 2nd round.).
Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was President from 2023-01-01 to None (Direct election 2022: 50.90% in the 2nd round (narrowest margin since redemocratisation).).
